question.prompt: Doug can paint a room in \(5\) hours. Dave can paint the same room in \(7\) hours. Doug and Dave paint the room together and take a one-hour break for lunch. Let \(t\) be the total time, in hours, required for them to complete the job working together, including lunch. Which of the following equations is satisfied by \(t?\)

solutions.explanation:
Treat the complete room as \(1\) job. Doug paints \(\frac15\) of the room per hour, and Dave paints \(\frac17\) per hour. Working together, their rates add to \(\frac15+\frac17\) rooms per hour.

The total time \(t\) includes a one-hour lunch break, so they actually paint for \(t-1\) hours, with \(t>1\). Multiplying their combined rate by their working time must give one completed room:
\[
\left(\frac15+\frac17\right)(t-1)=1.
\]
This is choice D.
solutions.title: Separate working time from total time
